note: From Light 1930 (Philippine Journal of Science 42), Glyptotermes chapmani sp. nov. For the alate the original has only a Measurements of alate table and no morphological description; the soldier and nymph descriptions are complete. The original uses mm throughout without marking each value.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: The original gives measurements only (mm): length including the wings 6.5—7.0; without the wings 3.5—4.0; wing length 5.0; wing width 1.35; head length 1.09; head length (to the clypeus) 0.9; head width (including the compound eyes) 0.9, (excluding the compound eyes) 0.8; pronotum length 0.476, width 0.88; compound eye length 0.23, width 0.19; ocellus length 0.095, width 0.057; antennal segment III 0.057/0.057, segment XI 0.133/0.095; labrum 0.30; anteclypeus width 0.38, length 0.135.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale smoky yellow or yellowish brown; mandibles reddish black; the rest yellow; hairs sparse. Head elongate, rectangular, slightly constricted in the middle, wider at the compound eyes, the anterior part higher than the posterior, posterior lateral corners rounded, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle; sides curved; frons falling steeply at about 45°; anterior margin bilobed owing to a median longitudinal depression; labrum about as long as wide, anterior margin straight, spine-like hairs in two rows, the longest about half the length of the labrum; anteclypeus trapezoidal, nearly 4 times as wide as long; postclypeus narrow, more than 4 times as wide as long; mandibles stout, strongly and evenly incurved at the tip, left mandible with 3 distinct nearly equal teeth, right mandible with 1 tooth in the middle; antennae 11-segmented, about half as long again as the mandibles, segment III shortest, segment XI longest; compound eyes distinct, unpigmented, circular, about 1.5 times their diameter from the posterior margin of the antennal socket; postmentum (gulamentum) greatest width about 2 times the narrowest part; pronotum as in the alate but shorter and wider, more than 2 times as wide as long, widest behind the anterior and posterior lateral corners, lateral margins strongly receding posteriorly, posterior margin weakly arcuate. Measurements: body length (abdomen extended) 7.0, (contracted) 4.0; head including the mandibles (extended) 2.0—2.15, without the mandibles 1.4—1.5; head width 0.9—1.03; mandible length 0.68; labrum 0.22; antennal length 1.08; pronotum length 0.5, width (dissected) 1.15; postmentum greatest width 0.27, least width 0.135.

sections.label: Nymph
sections.text: Body white to yellowish white, only the mandible edges and the mandibular articulation darker, abdomen salmon pink (intestinal contents visible through the cuticle); wing buds of various sizes; head very broadly oval; compound eyes unpigmented; pronotum shaped as in the adult; antennae 12-segmented, segment III more or less incompletely divided as the IIIrd and IVth segments of the adult. Measurements: body length 5.0—6.5; head length 1.1—1.35; head width 1.0—1.01.
